name: Flashcard Generation
description: Creates Anki-ready or paper-based Q/A flashcard pairs from provided study content. Produces specific, well-formulated cards following the minimum information principle -- one concept per card, clear question, concise answer. Use when a learner asks to create flashcards, make Anki cards, generate Q&A pairs for studying, or convert notes into flashcard format. Do NOT use for spaced repetition scheduling (use `spaced-repetition`), for practice test questions (use `active-recall-practice`), or for concept mapping (use `concept-mapping`).
